# Project Guidelines

- This is a Godot 4.7.2 GDScript project; use GDScript for game code unless requested otherwise.
- Favor small, playable iterations and capture design decisions and playtest observations as the game takes shape.
- Keep scenes and resources compatible with the Godot editor; avoid editing generated `.godot/` files.
- When Godot is available, validate changed scripts and scenes and playtest changes in the engine.
- Do not assume a genre, gameplay mechanic, target platform, or visual style without confirmation.
